name: ETF Screener
oneLiner: A screener for BlackRock ETFs: filter, sort and compare funds in one table.

screenshots.alt: ETF Screener: a filterable, sortable table of BlackRock funds

whatIBuilt: A screener focused on BlackRock's ETF range, built in February 2026 as my second project with Claude Code: a filterable and sortable table of funds with the fields I actually compare, deployed on Vercel.
whatILearned: Scope. GeoWatch tried to do two things; this did one, and it was done in days. It is also the first time I noticed that a Next.js app with a clear data shape is something an agent builds well on the first pass, which shaped the stack I have used since.
builtWithAI: Built with Claude Code from a one-paragraph brief and a list of the columns I wanted.
